bends.note: west leg (from 6th at x~1712) turns east along an open ~13 ft strip between the convent's south wall (y~1502) and a 5 ft brick wall (y~1552); west end of the strip is covered ('ceiling over boiler, br. arched & steel')
east leg (from 6th at x~2372, labelled CONVENT AL. again at y~1380) meets the same strip; the two legs appear to form one U-shaped alley (probable, not certain)

notes: Blocks Sycamore-Broadway 6th-5th (Notre Dame Convent, St Xavier's school, Wesley M.E. Church) and 5th-4th (Masonic Temple, Christ Church), plus Broadway-McAllister 5th-4th (Western & Southern). Two N-S alleys both printed CONVENT ALLEY (13' at 6th) enter the 6th-5th block from 6th; see bends. '?' = an unnamed ~30 ft street entering 6th from the north at x~2030 (faces x~1978-2082, block on sheet 134; name not printed here and not readable on the key map). PIONEER ST. (printed vertically at its west end, no width printed; faces y~1421 and ~1634, so about 60 ft) runs east from Broadway's east side, T at Broadway. Broadway is 66' north of 4th; south of 4th (sheet 118) it is ~100 ft with the east side further east, so Broadway/4th is the middle of the four corners (north leg centre x~2864, south leg x~2900), matching the sheet 118 pick. McALLISTER (33') runs 5th to 4th, T at both ends; its 4th St end is opposite nothing, Irwin Alley (10 ft, sheet 118) enters 4th from the south ~140 px to the west. No alley mouths are drawn on the west side of Sycamore (sheet 121/122 alleys are not shown here).
